thread:
Priya (Support): hi team — putting up an urgent escalation from AcmeCorp. They saw a big p99/p95 regression starting ~2026-03-10T03:00Z after our Optimize rollout. p95 jumped from ~230ms to ~560ms, p99 spikes to ~1.8s. No increased error rate, just huge tail latency. They say it started after we enabled a new quant_profile (fast_int8_fp8_v3). Ticket: ACME-4321. Trace id: trace-0x9cafe. Can we triage? :exclamation:
Victor (ML Ops): thanks priya. which model, request shapes, and are they on hosted or dedicated? did they flip any tenant overrides? that profile was in canary since 02:45 UTC.
Priya (Support): Model: redwood-large-rlhf-v2, hosted. Tenant: acmecorp-prod (shared hosted). No tenant overrides from customer side. Sample request attached (redacted). Short convo snippet: "bot responds but takes 2s on some requests".
Lina (EngRuntime): i rolled the canary for fast_int8_fp8_v3 at ~02:45 for ~5% traffic. initial perf looked ok, but we did see increased variance in stage. i'll pull runtime traces. @Ethan can you check infra metrics for shard hotness?
Ethan (SRE): looking now. infra graph: https://grafana/redwood/quant-latency?panel=acmecorp - clear p95/p99 spike aligned with canary. Not seeing CPU or mem saturation. but a cluster of requests hit shard-12 and we observed kv-cache churn. logs snippet:
```
W kv_cache: mismatch kv-length for model=redwood-large-rlhf-v2 shard=12 req=trace-0x9cafe
QuantCalib: calibration failed code=0x3A batch=128 seed=42
```
Victor (ML Ops): that "calibration failed" for the fp8 path is interesting. we saw intermittent calibration nondeterminism in staging when sequence-length distribution was skewed. if calibration fails, our runtime tries to use fallback heuristics which can force slower kernels and extra memcpy.
Priya (Support): customer is asking for ETA. they're seeing user-facing timeouts in chat flows. they flagged this as business-critical.
Lina (EngRuntime): immediate mitigation options:
- A) tenant-level override to force fp16 for acmecorp-prod (fastest fix)
- B) global rollback of fast_int8_fp8_v3 canary (if multiple tenants impacted)
- C) hotpatch runtime to set quant.toggles.force_fp16_on_calib_error=true so kernel falls back deterministically
- D) route acmecorp to Dedicated fp16 pool (if they have dedicated)
Which do we want now? i'm leaning A then C as followup.
Ethan (SRE): i can push tenant override now. API we use internally:
```
POST /internal/admin/tenants/acmecorp-prod/overrides
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "overrides": {
    "quant.profile": "stable_fp16",
    "quant.toggles.enable_fp8": "false"
  }
}
```
will need 1-2m to propagate to routing layer. i'll do it unless objections.
Victor (ML Ops): go ahead. also capture the exact request that triggers calibration failure and share. i can repro locally with the profile.
Ethan (SRE): override applied at 1890235000 UTC. response: 200 OK. propagation logs:
```
INFO overrides: tenant=acmecorp-prod override_applied at=1890235001
INFO routing: refresh config tenant=acmecorp-prod applied_shards=all
```
monitoring shows p99 back down to ~320ms within ~7 minutes. nice.
Priya (Support): AcmeCorp confirms :thumbsup: "latency looks back to normal, thank you". they asked whether they should expect a long outage or credit. i'll coordinate.
Lina (EngRuntime): for root cause: victor, can you paste repro steps you used? i want a deterministic repro so we can add tests.
Victor (ML Ops): repro steps i ran locally:
1) checkout release/2026-03-10
2) build w/ quant kernels
3) run:
```
./run_inference --model redwood-large-rlhf-v2 \
  --quant-profile fast_int8_fp8_v3 \
  --prompt-file samples/heavy_prefix.txt \
  --batch 1 --seed 42 --measure-latency
```
observed p99 ~1.8s; logs show QuantCalib failure and kv_cache mismatch on shard 12. if i force quant.toggles.enable_fp8=false, latency returns to baseline.
Lina (EngRuntime): good. suspected mechanism: the fast_int8_fp8_v3 profile chooses an fp8-kernel path that assumes certain calibrated scale factors and a KV layout optimization that reduces memory. when calibration fails for some batches (we saw it at ~0.12% of requests in production window), the runtime falls back to a slower path that does extra resizing and memcpy — that increases variance and interacts badly with high prefix-reuse (prefix reuse makes shard-locality high -> hot shards -> queueing -> tail latency).
Ethan (SRE): From infra side, shard hotness + fallback path = queuing amplification. since fallback occurs sporadically, you get long tails. not a full outage, but serious UX impact. no increased 5xx rate though.
Victor (ML Ops): next steps:
- immediate: keep tenant override for AcmeCorp until we ship fix (Priya/Support told customer)
- short: roll back global canary of fast_int8_fp8_v3 (Lina) to stop other tenants from being affected
- medium: add a deterministic guard in runtime: if calibrate() returns non-ok then set a 100ms fast circuit-breaker state that forces fp16 for that request origin or tenant
- longer: improve quant profile validation; add a CI job that simulates heavy prefix-reuse + long seq-lens and measures p95/p99 delta for each quant profile
- telemetry: emit metric quant.calibration_fail_count, quant.calibration_fail_rate_per_model
Lina (EngRuntime): i'll rollback the canary now and open a PR for the hotpatch guard. PR draft: "runtime: deterministic fp16 fallback on quant calib failure". also will add an alert if quant.calibration_fail_rate > 0.1% over 5m.
Ethan (SRE): rollback of global canary initiated (1890235250). canary traffic set to 0; clusters refreshed. monitoring watch: global spike diminishing.
Priya (Support): customer comms: i'll offer 10% usage credit for impacted window and explain we restored their tenant to stable profile. they asked for RCA timeline and mitigation plan — i'll provide updates after internal RCA. marking ticket ACME-4321 as "service restored" for now.
Victor (ML Ops): preliminary RCA note: combination of fp8 kernel calibration nondeterminism + assumption about seq-len distribution in the quant profile -> occasional calibration failures -> runtime fallback path with extra memcpy + KV layout mismatch -> increased p95/p99 due to queuing on hot shards. mitigation: force deterministic fallback to fp16 and strengthen profile validation.
Priya (Support): thanks everyone. keeping thread open for the RCA draft and followups. i'll update ACME and close once RCA posted.
sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-0423 created for quant-latency spike; priority: P2; assignees: Lina, Victor, Ethan.
